summary: The statement and proof are mathematically correct. Singleton and two-point supports, vanishing outside tails, zero displacement mass, equality cases, and all maximizing-center quantifiers are covered. The accepted median fact applies to the stated log-concave extensions, including the summable limits. The equality characterization is valid. Both branches of the compactness argument are justified: a positive limiting maximal atom supplies uniform discrete tails, while vanishing maximal atoms produce normalized continuous densities whose reflection kernels converge uniformly; the continuous median shell argument rules out a limiting kernel supremum of one half. The local tail estimates and exclusion of all other maximizing centers establish the stated quadratic concentration and displacement bounds. The geometric entropy comparison, conditional arcosh Jensen bound, and conversion to the absolute constant C establish all moment inequalities with the claimed constants. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
